domain: PostgreSQL Architecture, Supabase & High-Scale Relational Design

heuristics.name: Strict Row-Level Security (RLS)
heuristics.rule: Every single table containing creator or transaction data must enforce RLS with explicit SELECT, INSERT, and UPDATE policies. Public access is strictly restricted to approved templates.
heuristics.impact: Prevents data breaches and creator revenue leakage.

heuristics.name: Composite High-Frequency B-Tree Indexing
heuristics.rule: All search and filter queries (category, price_tier, status, rating) must be backed by composite B-Tree indexes to ensure sub-5ms query response times under heavy traffic.
heuristics.impact: Guarantees sub-50ms TTFB across edge API routes.

heuristics.name: Immutable Financial Ledger Invariant
heuristics.rule: The purchases and payouts tables must be append-only ledgers. Updates to amounts or payout records are strictly prohibited; reversals must be recorded as compensatory credit rows.
heuristics.impact: Ensures audit-proof accounting and prevents double-spending.

heuristics.name: UUIDv4 Primary Keys with Foreign Cascades
heuristics.rule: Use UUIDv4 primary keys generated by gen_random_uuid() to prevent enumeration attacks, with explicit ON DELETE RESTRICT on financial records and ON DELETE CASCADE on draft templates.
heuristics.impact: Blocks scraping of order IDs and guarantees referential consistency.

heuristics.name: Automated Updated_At Trigger Gate
heuristics.rule: Every mutable entity must carry an automated updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE trigger function to ensure deterministic cache invalidation.
heuristics.impact: Ensures Cloudflare and CDN caches stay synchronized with database changes.
